units.source_text: 但同時我也知道，只要徹底忽略它們的存在，

en.t: But at the same time, I also knew that if I completely ignored their existence,

units.source_text: 它們就會變成與我毫無關聯、轉瞬即逝的「科學幽靈」。

en.t: they would become fleeting scientific ghosts with no connection to me at all.

units.source_text: 我還聽說，如果在便當盒裡剩下三粒米飯，

en.t: I had also heard that if three grains of rice were left in a lunch box,

units.source_text: 一千萬人每天都剩下三粒米的話，就等於浪費了好幾袋大米；

en.t: then if ten million people left three grains every day, it would amount to wasting several bags of rice;

units.source_text: 如果一千萬人每天都節約一張餐巾紙，那該節省出多少紙漿啊。

en.t: and if ten million people saved one napkin every day, just how much pulp would be spared?

units.source_text: 諸如此類的科學統計，真的是駭人聽聞，

en.t: Scientific statistics like these were truly terrifying,

units.source_text: 每次我只要吃剩下一粒米，或是擤一次鼻涕，

en.t: each time I left even one grain of rice, or blew my nose once,

units.source_text: 就會產生彷彿浪費了堆積如山的大米和紙漿，這種錯覺使我無比煩惱，

en.t: I would feel as if I had wasted mountains of rice and pulp, and that illusion tormented me terribly,

units.source_text: 自己像犯下什麼大罪一樣，心情鬱悶沉重。

en.t: and my spirits would grow dark and heavy, as though I had committed some grave sin.
